relationship_to_f0_h0.new_estimand: out-of-player conditional action-choice improvement and immediate positional D-to-L discrimination from a fixed visible ten-term feature panel

formal_question.text: Within the observed PlayOK-like B2 train source domain, does the frozen revised ten-term actor-visible feature panel improve average-unique-player prediction of complete human choices on unseen source-domain players, and does its frozen prediction discriminate immediate positional D-to-L choices?
formal_question.separate_later_question: only after every predictive gate passes, test one-ply A_pos-preserving steerability as a positional necessary condition

observation_contract.unit: complete visible predecessor board, complete legal atomic choice set, observed human action, actor player key, and game identity

feature_dictionary.phase_handling: pooled primary model; placement, movement, and flying reported separately

changes_from_v1.material_balance_after: removed because material_balance_after minus closes_mill divided by nine was constant in all 48855 complete exploratory choice sets
changes_from_v1.creates_double_mill: removed because it means simultaneous closure of two mills and had zero varying choice sets in 48855 decisions
changes_from_v1.creates_mill_fork: added as the actor-visible double-three proxy; varied in 12744 exploratory choice sets
changes_from_v1.blocks_immediate_mill: replaced by the count of opponent immediate-mill destinations removed, which captures destination blocks and capture-mediated removal
changes_from_v1.opponent_mobility_reduction: added to represent constraining the opponent separately from preserving own mobility

confirmatory_model.model_family: L2-regularized conditional multinomial logit over each complete legal choice set
confirmatory_model.player_weighting: each actor player has equal total loss weight
confirmatory_model.malom_role: post-prediction positional A_pos and tier-loss labels only; never a predictor
confirmatory_model.zero_events: remain exactly zero; no effect-creating prior

choice_prediction.contrast: geometry control minus full tactical model

oracle_coverage.missing_policy: abstain and count against coverage; never impute

precision_execution_gate.why_structure_alone_is_insufficient: player-level paired log-loss variance and D-to-L event support are result variables; log loss has no finite structural variance ceiling under the current unfitted model contract
required_before_confirmation: implement the frozen conditional-choice estimator without reading protected content
use only v2 research-exploration players for player-level cross-fitted variance calibration
freeze numerical probability handling and optimizer convergence tests
demonstrate projected 80 percent power for the 0.01-nat primary effect at N=487
demonstrate projected 95 percent half-width at most 0.02 for the D-to-L top-bottom difference with the frozen event-support rule

decision_rule.do_not_execute_confirmation: precision execution gate is not met
decision_rule.future_feature_direction_rejected: any frozen support, identifiability, prediction, D-to-L, stability, coverage, or later one-ply necessary-condition gate fails
decision_rule.all_gates_passed: permits only another design decision; no E0, training, reward, game, promotion, or product claim

known_biases.history_recovery_selection: excluded 1751 games contain only 35 draws; retained 92789 contain 26157 draws
